description: Source code for the 'git count-objects' command, which counts loose and packed objects in a Git repository, reports garbage, and provides size metrics.

methods.name: bits_to_msg
methods.description: Converts seen bits flags to human-readable messages.

methods.name: real_report_garbage
methods.description: Reports garbage objects with size and path.

methods.name: loose_garbage
methods.description: Reports loose garbage objects if verbose.

methods.name: count_loose
methods.description: Counts loose objects and updates statistics.

methods.name: print_alternate
methods.description: Prints information about alternate object sources.
